lesson.title: Seasons, Holidays & Days
lesson.subtitle: Days before and after, seasons, holidays, and weekends
lesson.description: Talk about relative days and years, the seasons, holidays, workdays, weekends, and time duration.

learning_objectives: Name relative days and years: 前天, 后天, 前年, 后年, 工作日, 周末, and 新年.
Talk about seasons and breaks using 季, 季节, 假期, and 放假.
Express time lengths with 半天, 久, and 刻.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Calendar periods, holidays, seasons, and time-duration expressions.
overview.focus: Contrast 前天 / 后天 (days) with 前年 / 后年 (years), and use 放假 for going on break.

grammar_points.title: Using 半天 (bàntiān)
grammar_points.explanation: 半天 (bàntiān) means “half a day; a long while” (quantifier).

grammar_points.title: Using 放假 (fàngjià)
grammar_points.explanation: 放假 (fàngjià) means “have a holiday; be on break” (verb).

questions.prompt: How have weekend habits changed compared with the past in the reading?
questions.answer: Now people can relax every weekend and travel nearby depending on the season.
questions.explanation: The second paragraph contrasts modern weekends with the past.

questions.prompt: Write two sentences using 放假 and 后天 or 周末.
questions.answer: 后天我们学校就放假了，周末我打算回家。
questions.explanation: Use 后天/周末 with 放假.

questions.prompt: Which word means "the day after tomorrow"?
questions.explanation: 后天 means the day after tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Which word means "quarter of an hour (15 minutes)"?

questions.explanation: 工作日 literally means working day.

dialogue.title: Holiday Plans
dialogue.context_en: Two friends discuss when school goes on break and how they will spend the holiday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 后天就放假了，这个假期你有什么打算？
turns.pinyin: Hòutiān jiù fàngjià le, zhège jiàqī nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?
turns.english: Break starts the day after tomorrow—what plans do you have for this holiday?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我打算回老家过新年，前年我就在家过的。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn huí lǎojiā guò xīnnián, qiánnián wǒ jiù zài jiā guò de.
turns.english: I plan to go back to my hometown for New Year; the year before last I spent it at home.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 真好！不过老家的冬天是不是冷得久一点儿？
turns.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo! Búguò lǎojiā de dōngtiān shì bu shì lěng de jiǔ yìdiǎnr?
turns.english: Nice! Though isn’t winter in your hometown cold for a bit longer?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 是啊，我最喜欢的季节还是春天。对了，周末三点一刻咱们先见个面吧？
turns.pinyin: Shì a, wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jìjié háishi chūntiān. Duìle, zhōumò sān diǎn yí kè zánmen xiān jiàn ge miàn ba?
turns.english: Yes, my favorite season is still spring. By the way, shall we meet at 3:15 this weekend first?

patterns.title: Telling quarter-hours with 刻
patterns.explanation_en: Use 一刻 (yí kè) for 15 minutes past the hour and 三刻 (sān kè) for 45 minutes past.

examples.pinyin: Huǒchē bā diǎn yí kè chūfā.
examples.english: The train departs at 8:15.

examples.pinyin: Huìyì jiǔ diǎn sān kè cái jiéshù.
examples.english: The meeting didn’t end until 9:45.

patterns.title: Expressing a long while with 半天 / 久
patterns.explanation_en: 半天 (bàntiān) literally means half a day, and figuratively means "a long time" after a verb.
patterns.pattern_pseudo_translation: <Verb> + (completed) + half a day / a long while

examples.hanzi: 我在门口等了半天，他还没来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài ménkǒu děng le bàntiān, tā hái méi lái.
examples.english: I waited at the door for ages, and he still hasn’t come.

examples.hanzi: 这本书我找了半天也没找到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ zhǎo le bàntiān yě méi zhǎodào.
examples.english: I looked for this book for a long time and still didn’t find it.

guided_building.instruction_en: Practice talking about relative days, seasons, and holidays.

model.hanzi: 工作日我很忙，周末才有时间休息。
model.pinyin: Gōngzuòrì wǒ hěn máng, zhōumò cái yǒu shíjiān xiūxi.
model.english: On weekdays I am busy; only on weekends do I have time to rest.

substitutions.cue_en: Say you met your friend the day before yesterday.

model_answer.pinyin: Qiántiān wǒ hé péngyou jiànmiàn le.
model_answer.english: The day before yesterday I met with my friend.

substitutions.cue_en: Say you plan to travel abroad the year after next.

model_answer.hanzi: 后年我打算去国外旅游。
model_answer.pinyin: Hòunián wǒ dǎsuàn qù guówài lǚyóu.
model_answer.english: The year after next I plan to travel abroad.

substitutions.cue_en: Say there are four seasons in a year.

model_answer.hanzi: 一年有四个季节，各有各的美。
model_answer.pinyin: Yì nián yǒu sì ge jìjié, gè yǒu gè de měi.
model_answer.english: A year has four seasons, each with its own beauty.

paragraphs.hanzi: 过去，人们在工作日很少有时间出去玩儿，只有到新年或者长假期才能休息几天。
paragraphs.pinyin: Guòqù, rénmen zài gōngzuòrì hěn shǎo yǒu shíjiān chūqù wánr, zhǐyǒu dào xīnnián huòzhě cháng jiàqī cái néng xiūxi jǐ tiān.
paragraphs.english: In the past, people rarely had time to go out on weekdays, and could only rest for a few days at New Year or during long holidays.

paragraphs.hanzi: 现在不一样了，每个周末大家都能放松一下，还可以根据不同的季节去附近旅游。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xiànzài bù yíyàng le, měi ge zhōumò dàjiā dōu néng fàngsōng yíxià, hái kěyǐ gēnjù bù tóng de jìjié qù fùjìn lǚyóu.
paragraphs.english: Now it is different: every weekend everyone can relax a bit and travel nearby depending on the different seasons.

questions.prompt_en: When could people rest in the past according to the passage?
questions.answer_en: Only at New Year or during long holidays.

questions.prompt_en: What can people do every weekend now?
questions.answer_en: Relax and travel nearby depending on the season.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Say what you did 前天 and what you will do 后天.

model_answer.hanzi: 前天我去图书馆学习了，后天我要和家人吃饭。
model_answer.pinyin: Qiántiān wǒ qù túshūguǎn xuéxí le, hòutiān wǒ yào hé jiārén chīfàn.
model_answer.english: The day before yesterday I studied at the library, and the day after tomorrow I’m having dinner with my family.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Describe your favorite season and what you do during holidays.

model_answer.hanzi: 我最喜欢的季节是秋天，放假的时候我常去爬山。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jìjié shì qiūtiān, fàngjià de shíhou wǒ cháng qù páshān.
model_answer.english: My favorite season is autumn; during holidays I often go hiking.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: 放假 is a verb ("to have a holiday / go on break"), whereas 假期 is a noun ("holiday / vacation"). Say 放假了, not *假期了.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 季节 (jìjié) moves from fourth tone to second tone; 假期 (jiàqī) moves from fourth tone to first tone.
